pagesBefore: Before the change, the query read {pages} pages (measured with EXPLAIN ANALYZE, BUFFERS).
pagesAfter: After the change (rolled back, your data is unchanged), the query read {pages} pages.
transaction: Cannot try: the change contains a transaction control statement (BEGIN, COMMIT, ROLLBACK, SAVEPOINT), which cannot be undone. Not simulated.
concurrently: Cannot try: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY cannot run inside a transaction, so it cannot be undone. Not simulated.
probeSingle: Cannot try: the measured query must be exactly one SQL statement. Not simulated.
parserUnavailable: Cannot try: the SQL parser has not finished loading, so the change cannot be checked safely. Not simulated.
inTransaction: Cannot try: the session has an open transaction and rolling back would discard your work. COMMIT or ROLLBACK first. Not simulated.
